## 🔧 Technical Details

### Components Added:
- `CyberDashboard/index.tsx` - Main dashboard component
- `CyberDashboard.css` - Cyberpunk styling
- `locales/` - Multi-language support (4 languages)
- `services/mockApi.ts` - Mock API service
- `docs/index.html` - GitHub Pages landing page

### CI/CD Setup:
- GitLab CI/CD pipeline (`.gitlab-ci.yml`)
- GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/pages.yml`)
- Automated deployment to both platforms
